item.tib: rtsa gsum bder gshegs 'dus pa'i gter srung yum sras lnga yi bskul pa glog zhags me 'phreng
item.coloph: de ltar rig 'dzin chen po'i bka' nyan dam can yum sras lnga yi bskul ba 'di yang rigs mdun gyi grogs po sa trig sam sad gyis bskul pa la brten nas/ rig 'dzin chen po'i bka' lung bzhin du kho bo g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa'i rgyal khams kyi khol po ba phal pa ci lta bu des/ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i cha rkyen/ rnal 'byor ri khrod 'grim pa'i grogs po/ bon bstan mtha' ru rgyas pa'i ched du/ dben gnas brag gi ke'u tshang du yi ger btab pa'o//
